newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat, amid limited trading.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat, amid limited trading.

text.p: NWE oil products were essentially flat on Tuesday.
Gas oil firmed 75 cents in line with August Ipe which closed ast $167.75 a tonne. A German heating oil cargo moved at a steady August IPE +$1.50. Barges were quiet and spreads stable.

High sulphur fuel was steady at $90 prompt and $91-$92 a tonne into August. It was unbowed by talk of Russian cargoes arriving. Low sulphur weakened to $93/94 as a clutch of avails appeared on the horizon.
Gasoline remained very tight for prompt supplies with $203.50 offered on a eurograde cargo on August 1-15 dates. Dealers said the low $190s would secure a cif cargo around August 20.
